title: Augmenting Pretrained Language Models with N-gram Embeddings through Incremental Training
abstract: arXiv:2611.20415v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As a new scaling technique for large language models, the n-gram embedding improves the base ability of a model while adding almost no inference cost. Mainstream research realizes it through joint training of the n-gram embedding with the backbone, which severely restricts the settings in which an n-gram embedding can be used. We therefore propose training an n-gram embedding onto an existing model through incremental training, to extend where the technique can deliver value. Specifically, we explore several settings of the n-gram embedding under incremental training---the learning rate of the embedding, the vocabulary size, and the injection position---and train an n-gram embedding onto the existing model under the best configuration. translated_title: 通过增量训练将N元语法嵌入增强到预训练语言模型中
translated_abstract: 作为一种新的大语言模型扩展技术，N元语法嵌入在几乎不增加推理成本的情况下提升了模型的基础能力。主流研究通过将N元语法嵌入与模型骨干进行联合训练来实现这一目标，这严重限制了N元语法嵌入可适用的场景。因此，我们提出通过增量训练将N元语法嵌入训练到已有模型上，以扩展该技术能够发挥价值的范围。具体而言，我们探索了增量训练下N元语法嵌入的若干设置——嵌入的学习率、词表大小和注入位置——并在最佳配置下将N元语法嵌入训练到现有模型上。实验表明，增量训练下的最佳配置与预训练下的最佳配置并不完全一致；此外，通过增量训练学到的知识主要被写入到……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 本文提出通过增量训练将N元语法嵌入注入到已有的预训练语言模型中，突破联合训练方式的场景限制，并发现其最优配置（嵌入学习率、词表大小、注入位置）与预训练场景下的最佳配置并不一致。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes incrementally training n-gram embeddings onto existing pretrained language models, extending the technique's applicability beyond joint training, and finds that the optimal configuration (embedding learning rate, vocabulary size, and injection position) under incremental training does not fully coincide with that under pretraining.
